Alert

State of emergency declared

Kaikōura is in a state of emergency due to rain. The Kowhai river has breached its banks at 10.26am. Takahanga Marae is available for welfare & shelter for those who have needed to evacuate. Please check our Facebook and news update at the bottom of this page.
